_comment_retrieval_similarity_threshold: Retrieval similarity threshold is unified across run_eval.py and run_grounding_gate.py via config.similarity_threshold (or --similarity-threshold CLI flag). Retrieval evaluation uses top_k=5/20 with RRF fusion, while grounding gate queries top_k=2 with the same abstention cutoff.
